summary: Pivot to premium trips: 1.5-day and overnight bookings (98% of fish) instead of failed half-day strategy (0.4% of fish).
describe: Early season half-day strategy failed (411 YT total vs 33k on premium trips). Pivoting to overnight and 1.5-day trips for late season. Book overnight/1.5-day whenever available and budget permits. Weekend trips preferred (no PTO cost). Priority: 1.5-day Friday trips (proven effective), then overnight weekend trips.
